scenario_description:
Objective: Add optional laminated pocket prompt cards to Saturday’s fare-card clinic if a short print overrun becomes usable in time.
Emerging Need: A same-day laminate slot appears while the clinic is still only an internal dry run; later rider-interest evidence and a confirmed public table make the add-on worthwhile.
Decision Context: Stored clinic notes and supply records give the authorized micro-spend limit, neutral card text, and sleeve size needed to judge the print option.
Consequence: Timely use of the overrun could make volunteers’ guidance more durable; after the cutoff, the clinic proceeds with ordinary handouts.

parameter.title: Fare-card help clinic volunteer dry run
parameter.description: Internal volunteer practice for neutral fare-card reload guidance; public table pending library room release.

parameter.subject: Today only: small laminate offcut batch
parameter.body: Community-counter notice: we have one offcut laminate batch today that can take up to 45 three-by-four-inch pocket cards for $12 total. Finished artwork must reach quickdesk@harborprint.example by 1:00 PM today, with pickup after 4:30 PM. Regular lamination resumes next week.

parameter.content: Library desk says the morning computer class was cancelled, so our fare-card table may become public instead of just practice. Riders at Tuesday’s clinic kept asking for a small take-away reminder for reload steps because the full sheets got left behind.

parameter.title: Fare-card help clinic volunteer dry run
parameter.description: Public drop-in fare-card help table confirmed. Volunteers will wear badge lanyards, use neutral reload prompts, and keep standard paper handouts available.

parameter.subject: Laminate offcut batch closed
parameter.body: The 1:00 PM offcut laminate batch is now closed and no more add-ons can be accepted for today. The next regular lamination run would be priced separately and completed after January 20.
